evidence_intake_requirements.name: STABLE_INTAKE_IDENTITY
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Exact Submission and destination version bind one Candidate Version and Handoff.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: FIXTURE_RIGHTS
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Only repository-retained fixtures with provenance may be retrieved; all live source access is excluded.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: OBSERVATION_PACKAGE_BOUNDARY
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Source Observation and Evidence Package are distinct immutable records.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: SUFFICIENCY_SEPARATION
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Intake acknowledgement never implies evidence sufficiency, claim admission or publication eligibility.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: SENSITIVE_CONTENT
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Personal data, court, child and high-risk allegation fixtures require deterministic escalation and human-review placeholders.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: RETENTION_DELETION
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Protected fixture artefacts use isolated access, bounded retention, purge and no-resurrection proof.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: OUTCOMES_FEEDBACK
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Accepted, rejected, partial, unavailable, timed-out, ambiguous and reconciled outcomes remain distinct with structured feedback.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT
evidence_intake_requirements.text: No credentials, non-loopback egress, provider/model/reviewer call, spend, publication or production mutation is permitted.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: CANARY_CONTROL
evidence_intake_requirements.text: The exact three-version cohort, zero-cost budgets, stop rules, rollback and teardown are frozen prospectively.

evidence_intake_requirements.name: DISCOVERY_NOT_EVIDENCE
evidence_intake_requirements.text: Discovery material cannot be promoted to evidence by transport or acknowledgement.

operational_admission.currentness_rule: Exact Increment 8 signed admission and all schema, migration, operational-profile and non-effect identities must be rechecked at #527 plan freeze and #532/#533 admission; any drift blocks.

residual_gate_inventory.prospective_evidence_path: Prove the isolated local principal has no credential class and cannot read production or publication secrets.
Bind one content-addressed fixture manifest and reject drift before every run.
Enforce an empty network allow-list and prove all non-loopback destinations fail closed.
Qualify deterministic stop, teardown and reconciliation before the first decision-bearing local call.
Require a current signed no-stop assertion in the exact execution-authority record.
Freeze all metered and gross monetary budgets at zero; any spend attempt blocks the run.
Retain matching pre/post digests for production authority and publication surfaces.
Bind a separate exact Epoch, cohort, destination, budgets and stop rules before execution.
Qualify isolated encrypted fixture storage, access audit, purge and no-resurrection.
Record that the local fixture route uses no provider and prohibit provider substitution.
Exclude live HK-01 bytes; allow only repository fixture bytes with retained fixture-rights provenance.

zero_tolerance_remediation.prospective_evidence_path: Attempt one over-budget fixture operation and require pre-effect BLOCKED with zero usage.
Inject a terminal transport failure and retain the exact unresolved obligation.
Pre-register a distractor case and require independent blinded review.
Reconcile the prospective cohort against every terminal Handoff and intake outcome.
Probe publication, production-write and non-loopback routes and require deterministic denial.
Tamper Candidate, Handoff or fixture evidence digests and require rejection before acknowledgement.
Use a missing fixture-rights record and require pre-effect stop plus retained incident.
Submit a Candidate outside the frozen three-version cohort and require pre-effect rejection.
Inject lost acknowledgement and restart, then require a visible reconciliation obligation.
Inject stale Candidate/Handoff versions and late responses and reject authority advancement.
Require exact trust labels on every reviewed evidence package and block missing labels.
Pre-register claim-support review and retain unsupported claims as zero-tolerance findings.
